name: Sloth
intro: A sloth is a slow animal that lives in trees. It hangs upside down from branches.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A sloth has a round head and tiny ears.
It has long, curved claws.
The claws help it hang from branches.
Its fur can look a little bit green.
It is about as big as a small dog.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Sloths live in Central and South America.
They live in warm rainforests.
They stay high up in the trees.
They come down about once a week to go potty.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Sloths eat leaves.
They also eat buds, shoots, and some fruit.
They get water from their food and from dew.
Their food stays in their tummy for about a month.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A mother sloth has one baby at a time.
The baby holds on to its mother's belly.
It learns what to eat by licking its mom's lips.
It stays with its mother for about five months.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Sloths sleep most of the day.
Sloths are good swimmers.
Tiny green algae grow in their fur and help them hide.
Sloths are related to anteaters and armadillos.
Some sloths can turn their heads almost all the way around.

vocab.meaning: Tiny green living things that grow in wet places.
